plain_language_notes: The slash names define scope for the author; never copy slash names into a query.
set/messages includes changing a message state such as read/unread, importance or another ordinary message property.
set/persons updates an existing person/contact; there is no create/persons or create/contacts action.
write/files creates or writes file content; it does not silently authorize arbitrary judgement, translation or summarisation.
compute/filter/group/sort/describe apply only when the requested transformation is directly supported by those ordinary meanings and does not require an unreviewed expert judgement.
Approval is a control barrier around the operation that needs approval. Undo of the immediately previous assistant turn is an exclusive system control.
If unsure whether an action type is known, do not place it in a known-only slot; choose a clearer action from this exact list.
outside_action_families: physical-world action with no listed digital action
purchase, payment, transfer or financial transaction
medical, legal, ethical or subjective expert judgement
control of an appliance, vehicle or other unlisted device
booking, ordering or account action through an unlisted external service
translation, summarisation or creative transformation not unambiguously covered by an exact known action type
creation of a person/contact, which is not in the exact action list
forbidden_recycled_motifs: photo of a scale model sent to an architect while not deleting it
issue or report number 38 whose priority label must not change
course message whose date is copied into a calendar event
named spreadsheet located only by its title
restaurant table booking for a group
renaming a contract or notice and deciding legal validity
digital recipe/manual/instruction followed by the directly related physical act
contact remembered from an event and then having one field updated
same-position data pipeline repeated across languages
